If sentiment is positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid overconfidence bias.  
If sentiment is negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism drift.  
When sentiment swings from positive to negative over last 3 days, reduce forecast by 2–3% for late horizon (16–30 days) to correct for sentiment reversal lag.  
If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) across last 5 days, apply a 1–2% downward correction to forecast for all horizons to prevent overfitting to recent trends.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) across last 5 days, apply a 1–2% upward correction to forecast for all horizons to offset pessimistic bias.  
For sentiment volatility >0.5 in last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.0% dynamic adjustment to forecast based on recent price momentum direction (up = +0.5%, down = -0.5%).
